---
name: Visual / UX improvement
about: Report confusing navigation, inaccessible styling, or propose an original visual improvement
title: "[UX] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Where is the issue?

GitHub README / MkDocs docs / Local agent dashboard / Contributor workflow / Other

## What is confusing or visually inconsistent?

Describe the user task that is hard to complete.

## Current experience

Provide a link or a **synthetic-only, redacted** screenshot. Do not include PHI, tokens, emails, or private customer data.

## Proposed improvement

Describe the desired visual change. Mockups must be labeled as concepts; do not present them as actual implemented behavior.

## Accessibility and responsive considerations

Keyboard, contrast, mobile width, light/dark mode.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source links and navigation work
- [ ] Visuals are original or licensed
- [ ] No paid-only plugins or tracking added
- [ ] Existing validation/approval boundaries remain correct
